customer: I'm moving for a new job soon and I can't find the title for my electric car anywhere, which is just perfect timing. I'm in Brevin and wanted to sell it to you before I leave. What do I even do now?
agent: Sorry for the stress. Per our article "Getting a duplicate title in Brevin," you can request a duplicate paper title by mail or at any Brevin motor vehicle office, bringing your registration and a photo ID, and it takes 4 to 6 weeks to arrive. In the meantime you can still get an offer and book an appointment with us, but we can't complete the purchase until the duplicate arrives. Offers last a limited time, so you may need a new one; see "How long is my offer good for?" for details.
